This scan accepts one, so `` ```sh `` closes an open `` ``` `` block here while CommonMark keeps it open until the next bare `` ``` `` line. The two readings produce different closed ranges. In a file that quotes the markers inside a nested example, a marker can flip from "inside a closed fence" (prose) to a real marker and get paired — `totem init` then rewrites that quoted region and `totem eject` deletes it.
